title: Unit Event — Someday, From the Depths of Despair

meta.Event: Someday, From the Depths of Despair
meta.Outline: Realizing that quite some time has passed since she first met Mafuyu, Kanade starts a conversation about it on Nightcord. As the others pry deeper into the story, Kanade recounts the beginnings of Nightcord at 25:00.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A key change during the third measure and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay...
At this rate, I should be able to finish everything by tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, K, mind taking a look at what I drew for the chorus? I'm not sure if this is the right way to go...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But you're using darker colors than I expected. This song's more about wandering through a mist or fog as opposed to darkness.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Right... In that case, I'll stick with this design but try using some colors with more value...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, you guys...
Sorry I'm late. Everything going okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Sorry, I can't really say the same. I'm probably going to need more time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That's all good!
I'll use this time to look for some new tools and materials.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, Yuki. What's up?
You finish all your homework?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Yes... K...
I'd like to make some adjustments to the lyrics. Are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, we'll be in the chat room.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Let us know if you need anything, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I see...
Then, I'll try making adjustments based on that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Thank you.
When do you think you'll be done?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't have cram school or club activities tomorrow, so I should be able to finish it by the night after tomorrow if I sit down and focus on it.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <However, finals start next week for us, which means I likely won't be able to log in until the end of the month...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I understand...
Please be sure to let us know if there is a day when you can log in next week onwards.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I will. I'll get back to work now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This was about when dad collapsed too.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Kanade, make sure you keep creating your own music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's been two years since then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How about I clean and make you some extra food today that you can have later?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's been getting chilly lately, so I'll put on a pot of stew for you tonight!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: In the meantime, Ms. Mochizuki, I'll be working in my room.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, the kitchen smells nice.
I guess she did say that she's making stew...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I might go take a peek.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, Ms. Yoisaki.
I'm just about finished making the stew.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you. It smells really nice.
I'll be sure to have some for dinner tonight...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Would you like to have some now? It'll be warm and delicious coming right off the stove.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, that does sound good...
I think I'll have some if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, let me just get you a bowl... Oh, it's going to be very hot, so please be careful.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now that I think about it, didn't you make stew for me the first time we met, Ms. Mochizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We really didn't get a chance that time to talk very much either.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I remember going up to your room to let you know that your stew was ready, but I didn't want to bother you since you seemed so focused on composing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(She's right...
We hardly ever spoke at all back then...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Looking back, that was pretty rude of me.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's been two years since we first met, Ms. Yoisaki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I was so desperate back then.
All I did was compose, upload, rinse and repeat.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Eating even took a back seat.
Thinking about that...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm so much more at ease now compared to back then...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel like I have an easier time relaxing now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, you do seem much friendlier than before.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It must be because your group is full of such nice people.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Having people around that you can open up to makes it much easier to talk to others, no?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: People I can open up to...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The others must be busy with their new song right now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Weren't you bored out of your mind when you were all alone here, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu and the others sometimes come here with some sad feelings weighing on their minds, so it's okay if they're not always here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: After all, they seem much better now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Hehe. I suppose that's one way to look at this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But what if we start seeking them out whenever they do come here? Don't you think it'd be more fun for them if we're with them...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I never thought of it that way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
See my point?
Oh, why don't we go see them right now...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Isn't it a wonderful idea?
Let's go, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And we ended up talking about how things have changed so much over these past two years...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That's what you two talked about?
Actually, that's pretty interesting coming from you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, it feels like forever since we first started this group, and a lot has changed since then.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Especially after we started going to SEKAI. That's been one of the biggest factors.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Things do feel different compared to two years ago...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If anything, how we interact with each other has probably changed the most. I remember being so formal and as polite as possible with you, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You mean when it was just you two in this group...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It was really just K and Yuki back then, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I kinda have a hard time believing that now since the four of us are always together now, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, what was N25 like back then when you two were just starting out?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I've only heards bits and pieces about the stuff you did way back when, so I'm kinda curious...>
<Yes, we'd be interested to hear as well.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What?! Miku...? And Luka...?!
What are you two doing on my monitor...?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Sorry for the sudden intrusion. We were a little bored since none of you have been visiting SEKAI lately.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha. Alright...
But does that mean you were getting bored too, Miku?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'm interested in hearing more about your past.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Would you two mind telling us more regarding what things were like when you first started out?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Sure, I don't mind.
How about you, Yuki...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay... I'll try remembering what I can...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That was when I realized that I need to compose a song that could save someone... Someone like my dad...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And I've been working on music every day since...>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line:
This isn't good enough...
This kind of sound won't save anyone...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line:
It needs more bass...
No, even more...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: It needs to be able to save those who want to listen to this...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...? A notification from this video site?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, I forgot... I left notifications on when I uploaded that song yesterday hoping that I could learn something from them or use them as a springboard.)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <This is way too good. Who is this person? My jaw still hasn't closed yet.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I've never felt such a close connection to music like this before. It's been a lifeline for me.>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line:
(It may be just one person...
But I'm glad for them...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line:
(I have to keep composing.
More and more and more...
And save as many people as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: I won't have any reason to live...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line:
(Okay, it's all mastered.
I think I'll upload it now...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: (After that, I'll need to start working on the next one. I wrote some sheet music for it yesterday but...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: (The phone's been ringing nonstop lately despite me completely ignoring it... I guess I should see who it is...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <I'm glad you picked up. I've been trying to get a hold of you for a while now and was worried that something might've happened to you...>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm okay, really...
Also, did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <I'm concerned about your well being since you're living all by yourself now...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <Ideally, we'd be living together, but I'm so sorry... The doctors want to keep me at the hospital for observation...>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line:
I'll be fine, honest...
For now, you should just focus on staying healthy.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line:
So please, don't worry about me.
I'm okay.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: If that's everything, I'd like to go now. There are things that I need to take care of...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <I'll be asking a housekeeper to start going over to your place sometime soon.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line:
<Yes.
It has to do with you deciding to enroll in a correspondence school starting this spring.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <The goal is to have someone cook and clean for you since you may not have time to take care of housework while dealing with your studies despite not having to physically be at school.>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: I've been doing fine on my own.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: Besides... I have to keep composing...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: If anything happens, I'll let you know...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: For dinner... I guess this jelly should be enough. I haven't been getting that hungry lately anyway...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: More importantly, I need to work on my next song...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Wait, hey...!
You really shouldn't surprise people by taking pictures of them like that.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Haha. It's our graduation, so lighten up a little. I was just taking something commemorate this day!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You say that, but you realize that most of us are gonna see each other next year when we move up to the high school here, right?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
True.
Not many are gonna be joining us either, so I guess nothing's really going to change...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. That may very well be.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: At the same time, I'm glad that we still get to be together.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
M-Mafuyu...!!
You're such a good girl! There, there!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, you can stop doing that now.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'm looking forward to enjoying high school with you two.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Let's make high school really count, Mafuyu. Oh, we should take a picture to celebrate this moment!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Bye, Mafuyu!
See you when the new term starts!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That was a lovely graduation ceremony. I was incredibly moved by the speech you gave today.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You were...? Hehe. Thank you.
I'm glad I practiced it so much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Also, let's celebrate by getting you something you want. Is there anything that you'd like?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: A fountain pen, a book, you name it...! You can have whatever you like!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Really? Thank you so much!
But I can't decide...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll need some time to think about it...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: As far as I know, nothing.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And nothing's going to change moving forward...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I have to keep wandering in the dark not knowing what I want or what's supposed to be fun?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Even when I become a high schooler, go to university and beyond...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's all for my cram school assignments...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: <Hey, I found a really amazing song! You should totally listen to it!>

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: <Whoa, it's like these lyrics know who I am...>

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
<Listen to it, Mafuyu!
You're not gonna believe how good it is!>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I suppose I should listen to what my friends recommend me...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Gentle lyrics and a bright melody...
Is that what makes a song “good”...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'll just say...
<Yes, it's a wonderful song.>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hm? This site's recommending me this other video. It looks like another song, but something seems different...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Even if I did listen to it, I wouldn't feel anything...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This song... What's it doing to me...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh...
I'll be right there, mom.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's dark already...?
I spent that much time listening to that song?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The more I listen to it, the more it sucks me in...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(So much pain and suffering...
And yet, I can't not listen to it.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Nothing I saw or heard ever made me feel this way... Why this? Why now...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: The song I uploaded yesterday has 1,500 views...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: (More people are listening to my music now.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't know how many have been saved by this song.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line:
(I have to keep composing...
I have to save more people... A lot more.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: No, this isn't it. This doesn't sound right at all...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not happy with the melody and it sounds muddy overall... At this rate, I won't...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line:
I feel... Dizzy...
When's the last time I slept...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line:
Why's this happening...?
Now's not the time to eat or sleep...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I've listened to a lot of different songs now, but they don't do what this one does...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (K's song has such a cold and dark tone to it, but I feel compelled by it for some reason.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why is it that only K's makes me feel this way...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: None of the other songs have had this effect on me, and I don't understand why...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I just don't know...
And there's no way for me to learn why.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Even if I were to ask someone about this...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Would the person who wrote this song know...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This video even has a comments section. Just maybe...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But how would I phrase my question...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (“Why do I feel so moved by your song?”)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(No, that'd be a pointless exercise...
Also, there's no guarantee that they'll respond...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: And yet, it feels like another dead end...

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Good morning!
Did you see? We're in the same class!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And things probably aren't going to be any different.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'm going to have to keep up appearances by acting happy while not actually feeling anything at all...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, good morning to you too...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hold on, you were with the junior high school... Did you transfer over to the high school...?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Yes, the music teacher's going on maternity leave, so I'll be filling in for her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, I still get to be your student. That makes me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Hehe. I really won't have much to teach an honor student such as yourself, but you can always ask me about anything when it comes to music...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I still have plenty to learn...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Actually, would you mind me asking one question?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Yes, of course. Let's hear it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This song I heard the other day absolutely blew me away...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's like the more I listen to it, the more I get drawn into it. I've never felt this way about a song before...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I don't really understand why it's had such an effect on me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What would you do in this situation? I'd like to learn more about this song, but I'm not exactly sure how to go about doing that...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: If it were a classical piece, you could fairly easily find a book about the composer...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But this is song I found online.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I looked everywhere for more information surrounding the person who created this, but I've been having trouble finding anything concrete due to them not being very famous...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm not sure what else to suggest other than what you just said.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
But... You could try copying them.
Have you tried that?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: By doing so, you may make some interesting discoveries, such as learning why they decided to employ a certain sound or tone.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: It won't be easy, but I may be able to help you come up with some of that music.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Regardless, you're the talented Ms. Asahina. I'm more than confident that you'll be able to take on this challenge.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'll be sure to think about that...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Wonderful.
Anyway, I'll see you later during class.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I never would've thought about making music on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But what if this also ends up being another dead end...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I remember seeing one buried in this closet...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'm glad that I remembered dad buying this all those years ago.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It even still has its instruction manual.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It says you can connect it to a computer and record each note as you play along. This means I can create my own music...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I learned how to play the piano for a bit when I was little, so maybe I'll remember what I was taught by playing this.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I know. You must be looking for that study guide for medical school exams I got you the other day. I took that up to your room already.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome.
Study hard, okay? If you need me, I'll be hanging the laundry.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I should take this chance to move this up to my room.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I should be able to work on some music now that mom and dad are asleep.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Just connect the synthesizer to my computer and...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I've already downloaded the software for it, so I just have to try playing something now...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But how do I actually create my own music?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I might listen to that song again first...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Honestly, how is it able to grab at my heart like this...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I want to know why this song has such a hold over me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll start by copying the melody...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And I can make this phrase sound more impactful...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why did they go with this sound here...? It sounds so muddy...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Is it to make this particular part stand out...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Okay, this chord works well as a replacement...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(But it needs to sound sharper...
I have to keep refining it...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But it's shaking me to my core...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What if I altered the bass here and slowed it down a little? That might make it sound more complete...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I copied most of that song, but changed the parts that I thought needed changing...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I suppose this just makes it my arrangement of the same song...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I think I'm starting to get a better idea of what this person felt as they made this...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Which mean they must be suffering a great deal.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Like they're at the depths of despair...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That still doesn't tell me what I want to know...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(What was it that I felt?
Why did my chest feel like it was about to burst into flames?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What am I supposed to do next?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I was sure that this would lead me to an answer, but it ended up being a dead end.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hello there.
You've been studying since morning even though it's your day off. Very admirable of you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I made your favorite today. Stew.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thanks, mom.
I'll help set the table.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Also, Mafuyu, have you decided what you want for your graduation gift?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. The new term started before you came to a decision, so we can splurge a little by also celebrating you entering high school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm so sorry. I'm actually still thinking about it, but don't really know what to get.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Even after I said you could get anything you want. At the same time, I understand that you want it to be something meaningful.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Incidentally, I borrowed a catalog from a friend just in case you needed some ideas.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
For example, a wristwatch.
How does that sound if you're still undecided?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes. You're in high school now, so you'll be busier than ever, correct?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Which is why I thought this would be nice since you'll need to use your time wisely and efficiently.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Isn't it gorgeous...?
It'd be perfect for a young lady such as yourself and you could keep wearing it after becoming a doctor.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I don't know what to say.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Alright, I'll go with your suggestion. A wristwatch it is.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Wonderful.
I'll order it right away.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Even after I become a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Hearing that just makes a certain part of me grow cold and stale...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It has the opposite effect of that song...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Despite it having such a harsh and frigid tone, it has this...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The music this person makes feel so cold and painful. I can physically feel their despair.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This person desperately wants to disappear... But doesn't at the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My arrangement of that song still needs to be mastered and encoded before I upload it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Look at me. What am I doing...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (No matter how hard I try, I know that I'm only going to be disappointed. Why am I doing this at all?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(This person...
Are they really having that profound an effect on me?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I need to give myself a name...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It won't let me use just blank spaces...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's snowing outside...
But it's spring...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Snow... It feel so quiet and empty...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can start working on my next song while it finishes uploading this one...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've been getting so many headaches lately...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (On top of that, my hands and feet keep falling asleep, and I can't concentrate if my ears keep ringing like this...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(No... There's no time for that...
I can't stop... I won't stop...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'll just take some more headache medicine...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's just a URL.
Where does this link go? Another song...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
This person's name is... “Yuki”?
I've never heard of them...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They took my song and made their own arrangement...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(It's so poorly made...
But astoundingly clear...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(It's pure despair... Wait, no...
It's like they're in world that's devoid of anything.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This song has a very unique sound to it too...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Oh, interesting...
The chorus sounds completely different when it's arranged like this...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (They made it so the effects they put in really shine through and give the listener an opportunity to have all these different images pop into their head...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(This is incredible...
It's even helping me get a better idea of what I should do for my next song...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need to get started on it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have to put everything I have into these songs...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It sounds a little different from what I've been composing up to this point...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I hope this casts some light on that world...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe with this person, I'll be able to do more...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Everything's so blurry...
And I'm sweating profusely...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And who are all these people...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: They're from the housekeeping service that I mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: I know you said that you'd be fine without them, but I couldn't help but worry... I took the liberty of asking them to go over to your house.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You did...?
But why am I at the hospital...?

rows.Speaker: Housekeeping Center Rep
rows.Line: We rang the bell to your house several times but thought you were away since nobody was answering.

rows.Speaker: Housekeeping Center Rep
rows.Line: That was when Honami here realized that you'd collapsed, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, it's just...
It sounded like someone had fallen over...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line:
You don't need to apologize.
We were able to help Kanade because of you, so I can't thank you enough.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: Still, I'm surprised to see a young lady such as yourself working as a housekeeper these days.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Oh, actually, I'm not working as of yet.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: I asked my family if I could work part-time after entering high school, and they found an opportunity for me to observe with this housekeeping service through an acquaintance...

rows.Speaker: Housekeeping Center Rep
rows.Line: In any case, we were able to quickly call an ambulance because of Honami here. After that, we just needed the landlord to open the door for us.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: No, you don't have to thank me. I'm just glad you're okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: It's clear to me now just how much you want to keep composing and making music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: But you won't be able to one day if you don't stay healthy... Like your father...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: If something were to happen to you after what happened to him...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: I... I wouldn't know what to do with myself...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: I want to ask a housekeeper from this service to cook and clean for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: Would you be willing to agree to that...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What happened to dad was my fault...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That's why I have to keep composing. I have to make a song that can save people. Honestly, I'd rather be composing than wasting time dealing with a housekeeper.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If I keep living like this, it's going to start affecting my ability to compose...)

rows.Speaker: Housekeeping Center Rep
rows.Line: Wonderful. We'll be in touch regarding when we can start sending someone over as well as scheduling.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
Could we request Honami to be our housekeeper once she does enter high school?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: There must be some meaning behind you two meeting like this. That is, as long as you don't mind, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line:
...!
I'll gladly accept if I do receive an opportunity to work for this service.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: But for now, please make sure to get as much rest as you can after you do get home, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need to get back to composing as soon as... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right.
I didn't get a chance to upload the song I was working on before I collapsed.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I should do that now.
This song should be able to save a lot of people...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The way that person arranged my song...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Oh, interesting...
The chorus sounds completely different when it's arranged like this...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (They made it so the effects they put in really shine through and give the listener an opportunity to have all these different images pop into their head...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(This is incredible...
It's even helping me get a better idea of what I should do for my next song...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm getting a startling number of ideas for songs now.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's as if I could physically feel this sense of pure despair and not wanting to disappear.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Maybe with this Yuki person, I'll be able to do more...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If I create a social media account and send them a DM asking them if we can talk...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I can't motivate myself to do anything...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Someone left a comment for my video...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(<I'd like to work on making music with you as well...>
Thank goodness...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But how do we actually go about this. We could exchange files and our thoughts via email...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (No, trying to communicate nuanced ideas and finer details just through writing would be too difficult...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I know. What if we used something with voice chat?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I vaguely remember seeing a good app for discussing music and composition somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Let's see... It was called...
Oh, “Nightcord”.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'll see what Yuki thinks about using Nightcord, and send her a link to the app...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm in...
Now to wait until it's time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Trying to make music on my own turned into another dead end...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(But maybe, just maybe...
If I work with the person who's had such a profound effect on me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I might actually be able to change...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But it could still be another dead end...)
<Is this Ms. Yuki I'm speaking to...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Her voice is so soft but she still articulates very clearly...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This is the person whose song shook my heart awake.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<It's nice to meet you too, Ms. Yuki...
I'm K...>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <Thank you for replying to my message. It's an honor to be able to work with you like this.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<R-Right... Likewise...
Um... I can't thank you enough for agreeing to work with me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've never worked on making music with anyone before, so I'm not really sure how to chat or communicate my thoughts...)

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <I've been listening to your music for a very long time, Ms. K...>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <Yes, you make such wonderful music... And I couldn't believe it when you asked if we could make music together.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I see...
Then, I'm glad I asked...>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <Still, why did you ask me to join you? What led you to choosing me?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um... Because I listened to your arragement of that song I made, Ms. Yuki...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I felt some powerful feelings hidden beneath that sound.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes.
Your arrangement painted a very vivid picture for me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A world at the depths of despair...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But within that darkness, I caught a small glimpse of a ray of light.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's the kind of song I want to compose.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A song that can shine even a tiny amount of light upon that deep, dark despair...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I became convinced that I could achieve what I was after by working with you because you seem to already know how to express this feeling through sound...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(She knows it too.
That deep sense of despair...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And she's trying to shine a light on that darkness.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (With her, I just might be able to...)

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <I wasn't expecting to hear a comment like that is all...>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line:
<But I'm really happy.
Again, thank you for inviting me to work with you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anyway, shall we start discussing how we'll actually go about making music together?>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <So my job will be to mix your songs, Ms. K...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes.
Eventually, I'd like to add lyrics to our songs, but we'll start with this for now.>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <Understood. I hope we get to make some wonderful music together.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<That just leaves... Oh, right...
Would you mind staying logged in while we work? I'd like to use voice chat to discuss ideas whenever possible.>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <I'm sorry for not mentioning this sooner. My family's very strict, so I likely won't be able to start working until around 1:00 am...>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <Yes... That's usually when my parents go to bed.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Then, why don't we meet on Nightcord at 25:00? You can always let me know if you're going to have trouble making it...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<For now, let's call it a day.
We can start working in earnest tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line:
<Okay.
I'll see you tomorrow on Nightcord at 25:00.>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <Yes, let's. I'll start mixing your new song. Please let me know if anything comes up.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (We'll do things like this for now, but I feel like something's missing from this equation...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If Ms. Yuki's the type of person who prefers to focus on their work, then exchanging files once we're done with them should suffice...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (No, I should just let her mix this song...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want to see up close how she actually goes about what she does.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Okay, my rough draft up through the first chorus section's done...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(But the intro could be stronger...
It needs to be able to draw the listener in more.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Maybe I should ask what Ms. Yuki thinks.
But...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She seems busy. I shouldn't bother her...)

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <I-I'm sorry, I didn't mean to startle you. You were unmuted, so I was wondering if you wanted to discuss something.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I just finished the draft of my next song through the first chorus section and was wondering if you could take a look at it... Would you mind?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's like she could sense that something was on my mind.)

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line:
<Another masterpiece...
I'd expect nothing less from you, Ms. K.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This song's having the same effect on me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's like each note's finding its way straight into my heart and shaking me from my core...)

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <If I had to say, I think it needs to feel more stagnant...>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <I can feel a sense of urgency, like the walls are closing in on me.>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <There's nowhere to else to go. Nowhere to run...>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <But by making it feel more stagnant, you could enhance that sense of being trapped. It'd be as if there's nothing left to do expect silently watch as your limbs rot away...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (By doing so, I have a feeling that this song will have an even greater impact.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you. I'll take that into consideration...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Stagnation...
She's right. My songs have been somewhat one dimensional up until now.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'll try working in what she said during the post-chorus.)

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line:
<Ms. K...
Have you been writing songs for a while now?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I remember writing something really simple when I was four, but I started composing music on my desktop like this about five years ago when I was ten.>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <Five years? You've been doing this for that long?>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <Oh... And it's been eleven years since you were four, so does that mean you're fifteen now?>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line:
<That means we're the same age.
I'm also fifteen.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I was under the impression that you were much older based on how polite you've been with me so far.>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <Polite? This is just how I talk.>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <Would it surprise you to hear that I was actually a little nervous about talking to you?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Really? You too, Ms. Yuki?
Hehe. It wasn't just me...>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line:
<Of course.
I mean, this is my first time speaking to someone sight unseen like this.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Me too.
I always had my dad there to help me with this...>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line:
<Your father?
Does he write his own songs too?>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <I'm sorry for going off on such a long tangent. Why don't we get back to work...?>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <Please feel free to call me just “Yuki”. Now that we know we're both the same age, “Ms. Yuki” seems a bit too formal.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Why don't you follow suit by calling me “K”? I'd actually prefer that much more.>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line:
<Alright, K...
I'll talk to you later.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She doesn't seem to mind if I talk about things other than music.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's like she's willing to accept me for who I am and even seems to be okay with avoiding touchy subjects...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (We may be the same age, but she's so much more mature...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But based on that arrangement she made, it felt like...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right now, I have to keep composing...

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line:
<It is?
Thank goodness. That means we can upload it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I doubt I would've been able to do this without you. It encapsulates what I was hoping to express now thanks to you.>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line:
<I see...
I'm glad I could help.>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line: <What were you trying to express with this song?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, you mentioned how this song needed to feel more stagnant. That may be the best way to look at this.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Not a harsh sense of despair, but something more silent and gradual...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'll take care of encoding and uploading it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you for staying up so late to work on this, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: <Yuki>
rows.Line:
<Thank you as well.
Please let me know when the draft for your next song is ready.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'm glad I made this song with her...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's as if K's able to illuminate this deep, dark despair just through sheer will.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I didn't get any answers in terms of what I actually like or who I really am...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I really like how Yuki mixed this...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But she has ways to go when it comes to music theory since she only started doing this just recently...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And yet, she unquestionably has a talent for grasping a song's theme and finding ways to improve it.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Because she also seems to know “that feeling”.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She understands what it's like to be alone in the depths of despair.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Which means if Yuki and I keep working together, maybe someday...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Save me.>
<Compose a song that can save someone.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, I didn't realize that's what you two were like back then!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I remember hearing bits and pieces of that story a while back, but it means so much more now. You two really thought a lot about each other, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's been so long since then too...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I never would've imagined us becoming this close back then...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Me neither. After that, Amia and Enanan joined us, and we even got to meet Miku and everyone else when we started visiting SEKAI...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <We've had our ups and downs, but I'm really glad that we're able to talk to each other like this now...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She and Kanade must feel the same way...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Thank you for telling us that story...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'd like to thank you as well. It was interesting to hear.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Oh, I don't think I've ever seen Miku this happy before...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (She must care about them so much.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <So Ena and Mizuki joined after you two had been making music together for some time?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. After I started working with Yuki, Enanan and Amia uploaded a music video based on one of our songs...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I couldn't believe that you contacted me directly that time, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Same. My jaw dropped when you reached out to me.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Can you tell us about what Ena and Mizuki were like when they first joined?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<I'd like to know as well.
Would you mind telling us?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Seriously? You sure you wanna hear about that?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You're not gonna believe how prickly Enanan was back then. I mean really prickly.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<A-Amia...!
Don't give Miku the wrong idea!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What do you mean? I'm telling the truth, aren't I?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<So, Kanade...
Care to tell us more?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Well...
As much as I'd like to...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's a very long story, so we may want to save it for another time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What?! Crap, it's already 6:00 am!
And the sun's already coming up...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What's that, Enanan? You forgot about what you were doing because you were too interested in their story?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Shut up, Amia!
How much did you actually get done?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Unfortunately for you, I finished over an hour ago!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, K! I uploaded the post-edit video data to the shared folder. Mind taking a look later when you're free?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Ugh... I hate people who can multitask...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You know what? I'm stuck between colors right now, so I'm gonna go to bed now...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I think I'll log off too.
How about you, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I need to stay up.
My mom's going to be up soon.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Try to sneak in some quick naps when you can during the day, alright...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I think I'll take one now.
I'll probably be back on soon after.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I guess that's it for today.
Why don't we head back to SEKAI?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That time, when you invited me to come work with you...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That despair we both felt still hasn't completely vanished...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (We've all come such a long way since then...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to compose a song that can save Mafuyu someday... I want to compose a song that can save everyone.
